features.hud: UI FPS: last flush-ready notifications per elapsed second; not optical scan Hz
features.dma_staging: internal SRAM; LCD IO chunks at most 32768 bytes on ESP32-S3 SPI2
features.benchmark_source: LVGL v9.4.0 benchmark; 15 basic scenes adapted to an app-owned root
features.benchmark_metrics: completed UI FPS; no synthetic overall score or whole-chip CPU percentage

recents_memory.shows: free internal and external 8-bit data memory
recents_memory.refresh_when: recents visible; initial sample after app install

bilibili.bridge_origin: user-configured HTTPS; device Bearer header; no redirects
bilibili.account: Normal phone-confirmed QR login; account cookies stay on private server storage
bilibili.configuration: Physical USB JSON provisioning; device token stored in separate NVS namespace, never embedded in firmware; NVS executes on internal stack

console.transport: TLS 1.2 HTTPS with certificate bundle and hostname validation; no redirects
console.authentication: Device pairing via owner-approved short code and separately persisted Bearer token; ACK only after durable NVS save; explicit password fallback can remember verified hs_sid; passwords never persisted
console.chat: Explicit existing-session AI send/abort, default deliver:false; confirmed QQ delivery/direct text; request-ID acceptance; no automatic POST retry
console.input: Full-key K26 Pinyin with LVGL single-character dictionary; English, numeric and symbol modes
console.password_input: Dedicated six-column paged large keyboard; ASCII letters, numbers, punctuation and space; explicit show/hide, masked by default
console.chat_font_storage: Static const flash-mapped; RODATA copying into PSRAM disabled; code still fetched from PSRAM
console.background_network_buffers: Released by worker after HTTP cleanup; recreated on next foreground request
console.voice_input: Explicit ES7210 MIC1 capture,16kHz mono PCM16 WAV,max15s; HTTPS /api/asr/transcribe; result appends editable draft,never auto-sends
console.voice_server_requirement: MiMo pay-as-you-go key remains server-side; deployed ASR endpoint required
console.hardware_shortcuts: POWER GPIO16 active-high, BOOT GPIO0 and USER GPIO18 active-low; short release only; user mapping in NVS; app foreground only
console.supplemental_font: 7749 monochrome emoji/kaomoji/symbol glyphs; no full combined-emoji shaping
console.session_selection: Background reads do not lock controls; keyed selection barrier; explicit command ACK; content-based redraw
console.device_acceptance: pending; build candidate is not a flashed or accepted console

features.media_storage: FAT32 and exFAT microSD, MBR; no autoformat
features.video_volume: 0-100, codec update on existing video worker
features.console_send_recovery: Explicit local target-confirmed acknowledgement; never resends or clears draft; preserve last send HTTP result
features.device_pair_server_requirement: Reviewed device pairing server patch must be deployed; firmware alone cannot enable pairing
features.video_audio_sync: AUDIO-master PCM timestamp gaps remain renderable; only successful sink output advances audio reference; seek/pause generation gates retained
features.touch_guard: 15-byte dual-touch reports, hardware IDs and ACK; 8ms LVGL input period; stable primary pointer with all-release handoff barrier; app-local pinch; actual report rate and gestures require device validation
features.mjpeg_audio_admission: Local MJPEG A/V can release excess independent compressed video frames before decoding to keep demux audio progressing; bounded 256KiB compressed A/V pool; no automatic audio discard
features.avi_mjpeg_retry_timestamps: Pinned AVI extractor retry-counter compensation using the selected local MJPEG stream's exact dwScale/dwRate; no integer-FPS reconstruction; device A/V synchronization requires validation
features.video_pinch_routing: Blank chrome backgrounds pass input to video content; buttons and sliders keep exclusive hit targets; physical 40px edge start exclusion retained
features.video_presentation: Original memcpy, aspect-fit/fill opaque RGB565 resampling into two PSRAM buffers; 2880-byte internal row scratch, canvas 1:1; no source-resolution improvement
features.file_stdio_cache_memory: PSRAM; unchanged fixed internal SD DMA bounce buffer
features.lvgl_allocator: CLIB core allocation wrappers: PSRAM first, internal fallback; global allocator unchanged
features.settings: Wi-Fi disconnect/forget; BLE control and scan; PMU telemetry; internal and card storage; device details
features.audio: 2.16 pins, ES8311 output + ES7210 stereo STD input; exclusive app sessions
features.media_framework: Espressif ESP Player 1.1.1; audio/video render 1.1.0; Brookesia app UI retained
features.media_acceptance: FLAC audio and video performance require independent device validation
features.status: native Wi-Fi, read-only PMU battery telemetry, SNTP system clock
features.fps_hud: Single line at status bar center, x=190..289 y=14, noninteractive; detailed memory metrics on serial
features.fixed_staging_reuse: drain old DMA, copy, submit once through original IO; original completion callback retained
features.recommended_flashing: validated split images via Flash-Firmware.ps1 -Apps; preserves NVS/PHY gaps
